about_the_game:
Music is a miracle no less wondrous than the art of witchcraft. For centuries, minstrels have broken and mended hearts, exposed the vices of rulers, and sung the praises of heroes. A flute and a tambourine may seem modest tools, yet they conjure spells powerful enough to make a demon weep — or drive a homebody out on a quest for adventure.

Step into our tavern and settle by the fire! The jester's tuning her lute and trying to remember if she even knows how to play. And the witch's music? It'll brighten even the dullest of nights.

In this add-on, you'll find both the in-game soundtrack and original compositions created especially for this collection.

All funds from sales go toward further development and improvement of the game. By purchasing this soundtrack, you're directly supporting the dev team — and we're deeply grateful!
